overview:
Saudi compliance revolves around ZATCA: VAT, Zakat and income tax, withholding tax and e-invoicing all connect to your books. Entities with mixed ownership have to split results between Zakat and income tax, and invoices reported to ZATCA must agree with what you declare. We keep books on an IFRS-aligned chart of accounts and reconcile each of these to the ledger.

Delivery runs from our India team. Filings go through your ZATCA account or a licensed representative. We prepare, reconcile and support every submission.

faqs.q: Can you help with Zakat if we have foreign shareholders?
faqs.a: Yes. We determine the Zakat base for Saudi and GCC-owned shares and compute income tax for foreign-owned shares, allocating mixed ownership correctly.

faqs.q: Do you file with ZATCA directly?
faqs.a: Filings go through your own ZATCA account or a licensed representative. We prepare, reconcile and support every submission.

faqs.q: We are an Indian group with a Saudi subsidiary. Can you help?
faqs.a: Yes. We run the Saudi entity’s books, tax and payroll and provide consolidated MIS in INR and SAR, with Indian GAAP or Ind AS to IFRS reconciliation for group reporting.
